definition: You will rate your agreement with the following statements.
Use a scale from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree).
After each rating, briefly justify it in one sentence.

O_1.stimulus: I enjoy trying new things and exploring new ideas.
Now justify the rating you just gave in one sentence.

C_1.stimulus: I am organized and pay attention to details.
Now justify the rating you just gave in one sentence.
